# Support boundary project

This project demonstrates supported and runtime-dependent Eve filesystem surfaces.

asset.content:
# Eve runtime boundary

Run this project with Node.js 24 or newer, as declared in `/package.json`.

For Eve `0.39.x`, prefer statically inspectable filesystem forms: a flat `/agent.ts` or nested `/agent/agent.ts` root; one exclusive exact lowercase `instructions.md` or supported `instructions.ts`; recursive TypeScript `defineTool(...)` modules under `tools/`; TypeScript `defineSkill(...)` modules under `skills/`; directory-backed local subagents at `subagents/<name>/agent.ts`; and direct schema bindings.

Static inspection proves only those supported relationships. Dynamic registrations and Markdown skill candidates require repository-local runtime wiring and tests, or conversion to a supported static form. Remote agents, extension contributions, connection and framework tools, filesystem name collisions, reserved names, and advanced runtime behavior likewise require runtime evidence or a supported static form before they become canonical. Do not infer provider, model, routing, registration, or execution behavior from source presence alone.
